abort.already_configured: Access Roles is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Access Roles is already set up.

user.title: Access Roles
user.description: Roles limit what regular (non-administrator) users can see and operate. Add roles with "+ Add role" on the integration card. Administrators are never restricted.

user.title: Role
user.description: Users of the role see only what "Sees" and "Operates" allow and can operate only what "Operates" allows. An area covers all devices in it and their entities, a device covers all its entities. Permissions of several roles add up.

reconfigure.title: Edit role
reconfigure.description: Changes apply immediately. Pages a user already has open update after a page reload.

error.nothing_allowed: The role allows nothing: pick at least one area, device or entity.

guard_incomplete.title: Access Roles: read protection is incomplete
guard_incomplete.description: On Home Assistant {version} these could not be protected: {missing}. Restricted users can read data this way. Update the Access Roles integration.

incompatible.title: Access roles not applied
incompatible.description: Home Assistant {version} authorization internals are not as expected: {reason}. Roles were not applied; restrictions applied earlier stay in force. Update the Access Roles integration.

admins_in_roles.title: Administrators in roles
admins_in_roles.description: These users are administrators and are not restricted by roles: {users}. Clear "Administrator" for them under Settings → People if they should be restricted.

check.name: Check permissions
check.description: What a user may do with entities: see (read) and operate (control).
